rooms.name: Foyer
rooms.description: A marble foyer littered with discarded programmes. Rain streaks the glass doors.

rooms.name: Auditorium
rooms.description: Rows of empty velvet seats facing a dark curtain.

rooms.name: Stage
rooms.description: Boards dusted with rosin. Crates stand half-unloaded in the wings.

rooms.name: Dressing Room
rooms.description: Mirrors ringed with bulbs. The wall safe hangs open; the violin is gone.

rooms.name: Stage Alley
rooms.description: A narrow rain-slicked alley behind the theatre. Work boots wait by the stage door.

rooms.name: Workshop
rooms.description: A cramped workroom smelling of sawdust and greasepaint. A mended curtain panel hangs over a chair.
